title: Whoever causes harm will be harmed by Allah, and whoever causes hardship will be put in hardship by Allah
hadeeth: Abu Sirmah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said: "Whoever causes harm will be harmed by Allah, and whoever causes hardship will be put in hardship by Allah."
attribution: Narrated by Abu Dāwūd, At-Tirmidhi, Ibn Mājah, and Ahmad
explanation: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) warned against causing harm or hardship to a Muslim in any matter, in himself, his wealth, or his family, and that whoever does so, Allah will subject him to a punishment similar to his action.
hints: It is prohibited to harm Muslims or put them in hardship.
Allah Almighty takes revenge for His servants.
hadeeth_intro: Abu Sirmah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said:
hadeeth_ar: عن أبي صِرْمة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: «مَنْ ضَارَّ ضَارَّ اللهُ بِهِ، وَمَنْ شَاقَّ شَقَّ اللهُ عَلَيْهِ».
hadeeth_intro_ar: عن أبي صِرْمة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال:
explanation_ar: حَذَّرَ النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِن إدخالِ المَضَرَّة على المسلم، أو إلحاق المَشَقَّة به في أي أمر من أموره؛ في نفسه أو ماله أو أهله، وأنَّ من فعل ذلك فإن الله يُجازيه ويعاقبُه من جِنْسِ عملِه.
hints_ar: تحريم الإضرار بالمسلم وإلحاق المشقة به.
attribution_ar: رواه أبو داود والترمذي وابن ماجه وأحمد
